action_context_hypothesised_benefit: Provoked-seizure suppression: is the lithium effect general or GSK-3-specific, and in what order do the agents run in a first in vivo Wwox-null experiment.
compound_or_probe: Lithium; a second GSK-3 inhibitor of another class; a general anticonvulsant comparator; ethosuximide (INV-04); the NMDAR pore-blocker arm last.
documented_action_and_limits: [DATO and INFERENZA] Order proposed (IT, ADV-051, with the brief): ethosuximide first (the only arm whose outcome changes the decision), lithium in the same session as a positive-control-like arm with a second GSK-3 class and a general comparator; the pore-blocker arm last in vivo, after the slice arm, with its harms and stopping rules written first.
functional_comparison: More promising: not stated as an overall ranking; lithium is general, ethosuximide's selectivity is open.
mechanism_discriminating_control: Second GSK-3 inhibitor of another class (attribution control); general non-GSK-3 comparator.
measurement_that_makes_it_interpretable: Interaction ratio and the panel per age (as INV-04).
outcome_favourable: Second inhibitor reproduces a knockout-larger effect and the comparator does not. [K2 mapping, 2026-11-18, IT, from SCI's in vivo brief section 4 (priors file sha256 326846fb5180), mapped not authored: Brief lithium rows, read where the panel is valid and wild type above the floor. Lithium and the second GSK-3 inhibitor effective in all genotypes (interaction ratio between 0.7 and 1.43) and the general comparator effective -> favours a general anticonvulsant effect of GSK-3 inhibition and of the comparator (does not show GSK-3 specificity in the knockout). Knockout-larger lithium effect, reproduced by the second GSK-3 inhibitor and not by the comparator -> favours a GSK-3 route that is knockout-enhanced (does not show a p-Ser9 or kinase change, which needs the add-on in the same treated animals); the interaction margin for 'knockout-larger' is outside 0.7 to 1.43 (brief 9.1, set P5 of the priors), exploratory if the interaction cannot be sized. action_context_hypothesised_benefit: GSK-3 axis: what is measured in Wwox loss, other inhibitors, paediatric safety, the Wnt context.
compound_or_probe: Lithium; tideglusib; a clinical-stage kinase inhibitor; tool inhibitors; valproate (its GSK-3 action is contested).
documented_action_and_limits: [DATO, abstract and label level] One p-Ser9 blot is the only GSK-3 measurement in a Wwox-null animal. Other inhibitors have seizure results only in provoked or tool settings and not uniform: positive in several models, none in a Wwox model, a status-epilepticus worsening in one study, slowed kainate epileptogenesis with higher activity in another. Lithium has a paediatric label from age 7 (bipolar) and no infant treatment data (toxicity close to therapeutic concentrations; renal, thyroid, calcium effects); the one GSK-3 agent with adolescent data is tideglusib (16 subjects, 13 to 34 years). The sign of GSK-3 inhibition for myelination is divided across studies; the Wnt readings of the Wwox-null state predict opposite beta-catenin signs.
functional_comparison: More promising: none over the others; lithium has the most paediatric exposure of the GSK-3 agents.
mechanism_discriminating_control: A kinase or beta-catenin readout in Wwox-null tissue.
measurement_that_makes_it_interpretable: p-Ser9 after lithium in the same animals; a second, unrelated GSK-3 inhibitor.
outcome_favourable: A kinase or beta-catenin change in treated knockouts.
explanations_not_separated: Valproate's GSK-3 action is contested and it is also the general comparator.

action_context_hypothesised_benefit: Where the chloride-gradient branch (NKCC1 and KCC2) sits relative to the lithium and GSK-3 thread.
compound_or_probe: An NKCC1 blocker; the KCC2 branch (OV350 and others); GABAergic agents.
documented_action_and_limits: [DATO, abstract and one full text] E_GABA was never measured in any WWOX system; the switch of GABA polarity is region- and preparation-dependent and, in the mouse, close to the experiment ages (slice data P2 to P8 and P9 to P15 by region); the NKCC1 blocker is not more promising than the other candidates on any endpoint, with a hypothesis-level exception on development in other rodent models; the KCC2 branch is more promising than an NKCC1 blocker on development on evidence level only, not rankable against the other candidates; neither branch is more promising overall; both are gated by the same unmeasured state. The P11 mouse datum (Kasahara 2019) is WITHDRAWN.
mechanism_discriminating_control: E_GABA perforated patch at matched maturity, the bath without bumetanide as primary.
measurement_that_makes_it_interpretable: A depolarising null with a reduced KCC2 component would open a KCC2-activator arm only then.
outcome_contrary: A hyperpolarising E_GABA at matched maturity.
explanations_not_separated: Access to the KCC2 agent is an operator-level matter.
